title: Biased probability as an iid Bernoulli measure
statement: Let $p$ be a nonnegative real number with $p\le1$, let $m$ be a natural number, and let $A$ be a predicate on Boolean words. The biased probability that $A$ holds of a sampled length-$m$ word, with each bit true with probability $p$, equals the probability of the set of length-$m$ Boolean vectors whose corresponding word satisfies $A$, under the product measure of $m$ independent Bernoulli bits of parameter $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a predicate on Boolean words
